slides.headline: Nerves and pressure are *the usual reasons* things end sooner than you’d like.
slides.body: Over-excitement, anxiety, being out of practice or simply rushing all play a part. It’s rarely a medical problem, and it isn’t a flaw.
slides.note: From intimova.ng: How to last longer in bed.

slides.headline: Slow your breathing. *Fast, shallow breaths rush you.*
slides.body: Slow breaths keep you present, and in control.

slides.kicker: MAKE IT ABOUT BOTH OF YOU
slides.headline: It’s not a performance *to pass.*
slides.body: Take your time with everything before. When the night isn’t riding on how long you last, the pressure eases.

slides.headline: Pressure is the enemy. *Slowing down is the fix.*
slides.lead: Save this for the night it matters. Full guide: link in bio.
